features.title: One port for version-control providers
features.summary: Providers serve the same dshx API id under their own owner; a caller asks every served provider which claims a path and uses the highest priority one to isolate a thread or snapshot and restore files.
failureModes: A provider whose detect fails is skipped instead of failing the caller.
A path no provider claims resolves to nothing, so the caller keeps the project checkout.

verification.testName: picks the highest-priority provider that claims the path
answers nothing when no provider claims the path or none is loaded
resolves the provider through the Effect service, skipping a provider whose detect fails

features.title: Which VCS owns a path
features.summary: VcsDetector (subpath ./detect) names jj or git for a path from the nearest .jj or .git above it, jj first when both exist, reading only the filesystem; jj-integration and pulls-review pick their jj or git adapter with it.
failureModes: A path outside any repository, or one deleted meanwhile, detects nothing and kindOf reads it as jj so callers keep their jj errors.

verification.testName: prefers jj in a colocated checkout, picks git for a git-only one, and reads the nearest marker
reads a folder outside any repository, or one deleted meanwhile, as jj so its errors stay unchanged

telemetry.reason: Pure filesystem existence checks with no process, socket or network; the caller's span covers them.
